content.value: Use nested traversal for totals, counts, extrema, and locating values. A row total resets inside the outer row loop. A column total keeps the column fixed while rows vary. A square matrix has main-diagonal positions [i][i]. Check dimensions before using grid[0] or initializing from the first cell.

For {{1, 2}, {3, 4}}, the row totals are 3 and 7. Initializing rowSum outside the outer loop would instead print cumulative totals 3 and 10. For neighbor algorithms, check boundaries before visiting row - 1 or col + 1.
Practice: trace the example by hand, change one input, and explain how the result changes. Check an empty or boundary case when the preconditions allow it.
